description: Boulder County Public Works publishes a point inventory of stormwater inlets. The schema identifies inlet type and dimensions, grate width and depth, top and invert elevations, number of openings, catch basin, water source, road location, ownership and maintenance. Dimension aliases specify inches. These locations and inlet attributes can support representation of runoff entry points in drainage simulation. The inventory combines field collection during April to December 2017 with plans and subsequent county work. The metadata does not establish capture coefficients, blockage condition, current inlet capacity or validated connections to the pipe network. County staff maintain the layer as part of their asset-management system. Coverage is limited to the provider-described county infrastructure. Public catalogue and layer metadata are free to access. The catalogue supplies CC BY 4.0 licensing. ArcGIS layer metadata and the landing page returned HTTP 200. Export bodies and feature rows were not downloaded; distribution usability remains unverified. Related records cover other infrastructure layers in this county catalogue. The county overview has inconsistent licence wording; this record preserves the explicit layer-feed licence URL.
